title: Ping Order
statement: Implement `solve()`. Using the same diamond D(B, C), B(A), C(A), each class defines ping that appends its own name and then calls super().ping(). Return the list of names recorded by D().ping().
hints: Append the class name, then super().ping().
A's ping appends and does not need a further super if you stop at A. Include A.
Call ping on a D instance.

approaches.name: Direct
approaches.explanation: super() follows the instance's MRO, not the class that wrote the method.

editorial: super() follows the instance's MRO, not the class that wrote the method. Cooperative ping on D therefore records D, B, C, A. Calling B.ping(self) directly from D skips C. The recorded names are the proof the chain was cooperative.
